description_en: Deletes the specified iSCSI gateway block volumes
description_zh: 删除指定的块网关块卷
kebab_example: aliyun sgw delete-gateway-block-volumes --gateway-id gw-000eg44nmxbsfwb000 --index-id NFSalex-gx000 --is-source-deletion true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteGatewayBlockVolumes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the index. You can call the DescribeGatewayBlockVolumes operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 索引ID。可以通过DescribeGatewayBlockVolumes接口获得
parameters.name: index_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete the source data. Valid values:

true: When the iSCSI gateway volume is deleted, the data in the OSS bucket is also deleted. Proceed with caution.
false: When the iSCSI gateway volume is deleted, the data in the OSS bucket is not deleted. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除源数据。可能值：

true：删除块网关卷时同时删除云上OSS Bucket中的数据，请谨慎操作。

false：删除块网关卷时不删除云上OSS Bucket中的数据。
默认false
parameters.name: is_source_deletion
